text:
Maya: Following the postmortem, I want to capture the concrete eval/testing follow-ups and whos actually doing what. We observed a recurring token-boundary stall pattern across a few deploys. Proposed deliverables: curated prompt set (regression + adversarial), nightly regression job, replayable load harness, and a formal chaos drill with post-drill evals. Drop owners and rough ETA.

Carlos: I can take the curated prompt set + adversarial perturbations. Plan: 3 days to assemble seeds + 2 days to add to evals repo and wire metrics.

Priya: Ill own the nightly regression job and dashboard wiring. Need a prometheus metric from the eval runner and a Grafana panel. Estimate 4 days.

Tom: Ill do the replayable load harness and a small suite of traffic replays (steady + burst + sequence-edge cases). Need sandbox infra. Estimate 5 days incl. tuning.

Maya: Great. Also want to tag recurring incidents and add a mapping from failure class -> eval bucket so future alerts auto-suggest tests. Carlos, can you annotate the prompt set with failure labels?

Carlos: Yup. Ill add labels like: truncation-edge, kv-cache-stall, streaming-cut, and measure severity. Will include acceptance criteria in the PR.

Priya: Asked infra for a stable artifact for the eval runner (we're seeing nondeterminism with quantized builds). @Ops-bot can you create a ticket to snapshot a determinism-enabled model image and prep a test artifact?

Ops-bot: Ticket INF-6001 created: snapshot model artifact + provision gpu sandbox for replay tests. ETA 4 business days.

Tom: Sample k6 replay script i'll start from: 
```
import http from 'k6/http';
import {sleep} from 'k6';
export default function() {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({prompt: open('burst_prompt.json')});
  http.post('https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate', payload, {headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
  sleep(0.1);
}
```
Will add exact token-length distributions from the incident logs.

Carlos: For the prompt set acceptance: propose metrics -> regen_rate (how often response truncates), hallucination_rate within 50 tokens of truncation, and top-k token drift. Target: regen_rate < 0.5% for 10k tokens on nightly.

Priya: For CI gating: I suggest two gates: presubmit (fast smoke: 200 seeds) and nightly (full set + load replay). Presubmit should block merges if regen_rate regressed > 2% vs baseline. Nightly alerts ops + eng if >1.5% for 3 consecutive runs. Thoughts?

Maya: Sounds reasonable. For ownership: Carlos owns promptset + labels (5d), Priya owns CI + dashboard (4d), Tom owns load harness (5d), Maya to coordinate the chaos drill and map incident tags to eval buckets (3d).

Tom: I'll push a repo skeleton under git.internal/redwood/load-replays and open a WIP PR once sandbox is ready.

Carlos: Opening PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/evals/pulls/441  contains 200 initial seeds and a README. Will add metadata and expected metrics tomorrow. :mag:  Feedback welcome.

Priya: I'll wait for the /metrics endpoint. Carlos, can you add a simple Prom exporter for the eval run? Even a few counters is enough (truncations_total, requests_total, hallucinations_total).

Carlos: Yep, will add prometheus /metrics and an example prometheus scrape job in the PR.

Maya: One more recurring-incident point: we saw the failure spike correlate with a specific routing fallback to the quantized variant. Action: create a canary plan that exercises fallback path during chaos drill. Priya/Tom coordinate on that.

Priya: Will add a canary run to the nightly matrix (isolated job). Tom: include a replay that forces the fallback route.

Tom: will do. Also will include a script to randomize sequence offsets to surface boundary conditions.

Maya: I'll create the tracking issue in the postmortem project board and link PRs + infra ticket. Assigning weekly 15m check-ins until items are closed. First check-in next Monday.

Ops-bot: Created tracking issue PM-2107 in Postmortem board and linked INF-6001 and PR 441.

Carlos: :thumbsup: I'll add failure-label mapping to the PR description.

Priya: :white_check_mark: Will draft Grafana panels and alert rules and attach to the tracking issue.

Tom: :rocket: I'll ping when repo skeleton is up.

Maya: Thanks team  please update the tracking issue as you make progress and add subtask checkboxes. If anyone needs more runway, flag it here.
